alex: Heads up: PR #4129 stuck in merge queue — macOS integ failed 1/32 with snapshot diff. CI link: https://ci.redwood.test/builds/4129
Failure looks nondeterministic, not seen locally. Can someone with a mac run a targeted rerun? I don't want to update snapshots until we confirm.

ci-bot: CI: job 'macos-integ/shard-12' failed on test 'render_pipeline/snapshot_compare'. Rerun available via /rerun-targeted 4129 shard=12

maya: I'll kick a targeted rerun in a min. If it flakes we should bisect or add a flaky skip.

lee: /rerun-targeted 4129 shard=12
Started rerun — will post results.

ci-bot: Rerun started by lee. Job 4129-rr-7 queued

ci-bot: Rerun completed: PASS. Original failed run had a rendering whitespace mismatch.
Log snippet:
```
Expected: "...rendered widget\n"
Actual:   "...rendered widget \n"
Diff at line 102
```
Marked flaky if inconsistent across runs.

alex: OK if rerun passed, I'm leaning no snapshot update. The diff seems whitespace-only and could be nondet from layout rounding. We have a previous flake in this test last month.

toni: I can repro locally on my Mac mini — small DPI rounding sometimes adds trailing space on line breaks. Suggest adding normalize_whitespace() helper in test and a follow-up to harden rendering checks.

maya: Sounds good. For now can we get one approve so it can merge in next window? @toni any chance you can leave an approval after you queue the follow-up?

toni: I'll push the helper in a follow-up PR and approve this one. Approving now :thumbsup: 

alex: Thanks all. Merging after CI stable for 10m window. I'll file a bug with repro steps and reference this thread.
